drafts.title: Review comments
drafts.sub: agnts's comments stay here until you accept them. Only accepted ones are published on {host}, together as one review; the rest never leave agnts.
drafts.lockedSub: The review is over or the pull request is closed: these comments can only be read.
drafts.reasonLabel: Why? (optional: agnts learns what you call noise)
drafts.reasonHint: e.g. we never bound caches in this service
drafts.outdatedHint: agnts's newest review no longer finds this.
drafts.deleteConfirm: It was never published; it is deleted from agnts.
drafts.publishSub: {n, plural, one {This comment goes} other {These # comments go}} on the pull request as one review, as the {host} token's user. Comments not on a changed line go in the review's text.
drafts.publishedToast: {n, plural, one {# comment published} other {# comments published}} on {host}
drafts.headMoved: New commits since agnts reviewed it ({from}, now {to}): the comments go on the version agnts reviewed, and {host} may show them as outdated. To put them on the newest lines, review it again first.
drafts.notOnDiff: agnts's comments not on a line shown here (another version, or outside the diff):
drafts.addedToast: Added to the review: it is published with the accepted comments
drafts.reviewSub: agnts reviews the pull request as it is now. Its comments stay drafts in agnts until you accept them; only accepted ones go on the pull request. Approving the review merges it only when it is assigned to you or asks for your review.
drafts.focusHint: e.g. the migration and the retry logic
drafts.deepLabel: Deep review (security, failures, tests and types passes)
drafts.reviewingNow: agnts is reviewing this pull request ({key}). Its comments appear here as drafts when it is done.
drafts.finishConfirm: Finish the review of #{number}? Comments not published stay in agnts. The pull request is left as it is: agnts does not merge it.
drafts.readySub: Go through agnts's comments, publish the ones you agree with on {host}, then finish the review. Or review again with a note, or dismiss it.
drafts.finishedSub: The review of #{number} is finished. The pull request was left as it is.
